description: On a reader throw, enrichOnChain flags earn_src='unverified' but does NOT clear the field: because e = {...row}, the SELF-ASSERTED revenue_mo_usd / net_worth_usd from the Supabase row survive untouched (only overwritten on success). R3 says the figure is 'flagged (never trusted)'. It IS still trusted by aggregate.js:35: selfFunded = rows.filter(r => r.status!=='dead' && r.revenue_mo_usd/30 >= r.burn_day_usd) reads revenue_mo_usd for EVERY row with no earn_src gating. So a row whose chain read failed (or that was never enriched — the live dashboard-sync path) drives self_funded_pct from a self-reported number. The served 'X% self-funded' headline is therefore self-asserted, not chain-verified — a no-fake violation shipped this sprint.

evidence.snippet: const selfFunded = rows.filter((r) => r.status !== "dead" && r.revenue_mo_usd / 30 >= r.burn_day_usd).length;

fix: Gate selfFunded on earn_src==='chain' (and/or have enrich null out unverified figures so no self-asserted value can leak into any derived stat).
